quarterly_data.quarter: DigitalOcean press release: DigitalOcean Introduces Agent Droplets: Everything an AI (10-01-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: DigitalOcean introduced Agent Droplets, available from October 1, 2026 in all regions where Managed Agents is offered: one monthly subscription bundling Managed Agents resources - Harness Runtime microVM sandboxes (start in about a second, resume from pause in about 300 milliseconds in DigitalOcean testing), Inference Engine on DigitalOcean-hosted open models including Kimi K3 and GLM 5.3, and Action Gateway access to more than 16,000 tools - with unlimited agents and no seat charges. Two sizes: Pro at $50 a month with a 15% discount and Team at $200 a month with a 20% discount on included usage; frontier models such as Claude and GPT stay pay-as-you-go at list price. It also launched Inference and Agents Balance, a prepaid balance of $5 to $500 usable only for Serverless Inference, Action Gateway and Managed Agents.
quarterly_data.figure: Pro $50 a month (15% discount); Team $200 a month (20% discount)
